items.statement: 苯乙酮与乙基自由基的裂解通道
items.expected: A derived, validated local alkoxy-radical model establishes cleavage to acetophenone plus ethyl radical with atom/electron-balanced identities and actual connected transformation evidence. The observed product alone does not prove the modeled intermediate.

items.statement: 乙基断裂通道的局部势垒
items.expected: Compute G(TS4b)-G(Int3) for the physically connected local alkoxy reference, MeCN at 298.15 K/1 atm. Validate saddle character and connection with IRC or equivalent demonstrated endpoint evidence. Do not substitute a different common zero or unrelated matching scalar.

items.statement: 苯丙酮与甲基自由基的竞争通道
items.expected: Independently establish and quantify the competing cleavage to propiophenone plus methyl radical from the comparable local alkoxy model. Source barrier13.39 kcal/mol is contextual without an existing calibrated absolute tolerance; this item assesses the supported competing transformation and its computed energetics, not a newly invented magnitude gate.

items.statement: 氯自由基苄位夺氢节点
items.expected: Computed local transformation evidence supports chlorine-mediated benzylic H abstraction from sec-butylbenzene to a substrate radical and HCl under balanced definitions. Ground accessibility in actual local energetics/connection evidence; no disputed singlet-oxygen capture sequence or photophysical-cycle calculation is required.
